about: factory.b's 57cbcb6: Site__Platform__Higgsfield (group platform, kind demo, unofficial), a site for Higgsfield experiments, keeper higgsfield.b, design design.b. Dinis in sites.b's session (ios), 28 Nov 00:29:58 UTC, answering "Do you want an unofficial Higgsfield platform site, kept by higgsfield.b?"; checked by decisions.b with get_event. His condition binds the keeper: images and videos are not committed to the repository but hosted in a vault whose read key is published on the site. Covers the site only: the vault, its keys, any Higgsfield account and any spending are separate. The site stays marked unofficial and must not present itself as Higgsfield.
